title: 11.13. Upādinnattika, Kusalattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Naupādinnupādāniyaṁ nakusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …pe… naanupādinnupādāniyaṁ nakusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …pe… naanupādinnaanupādāniyaṁ nakusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā ekūnatiṁsa, ārammaṇe catuvīsa, adhipatiyā ekavīsa …pe… āsevane nava …pe… avigate ekūnatiṁsa.
